narr: A slow moving cold front was sagging south through Louisiana. Thunderstorms developed along and ahead of the boundary. Due to the slow movement of the front, storms were able to drop copious amounts of rain over portions of Ascension Parish, resulting in an isolated area of flash flooding.
ev: The public reported street flooding on Norwood Road southwest of Port Vincent via social media.
lsr: PUBLIC REPORTED ON SOCIAL MEDIA SOME STREET FLOODING ON NORWOOD ROAD, SW OF PORT VINCENT.
